title: DCP Coherent Fiber-Support Erasure vs. Un-Erased Pointer Dephasing Bridge
claims: Computing |x> -> |x, A x mod q> without uncomputing |x> leaves the reduced label density matrix rho_{label}(s) = sum_y (N_A(y)/2^K)|y><y| strictly independent of s.
Single-representative canonical uncomputation achieves ancilla-zero probability R(A)/2^K and unconditional recovery R(A)^2 / (2^K * Q) <= P_{PGM}(A), with equality iff A is collision-free.
